0022600207.text: The Pacers (3-7), 11th in the East and 3-2 on the road but 0-5 at home, come in on a one-game losing streak as they visit the Mavericks (5-4), who are on a one-game winning streak and sit 10th in the West. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), who averages 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game, along with Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have met once this season, with Dallas winning 121-105 in Indianapolis on October 23, leaving the Pacers trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 0-2 to Dallas in 2025-26.
